title: The Atelier
description: AI-enabled bean-to-cup coffee machine that learns your taste cup by cup, reads your calendar, and reorders beans automatically.
facts: Price: $2,199 (or $184/month for 12 months).
Category: Bean-to-cup coffee machine.
Learns your taste preferences over approximately 7 days and creates personalized 'flavour DNA' per user.
Supports up to 6 household member profiles.
Analyzes time of day, calendar events, weather, and household activity to adjust brewing.
Automatically warms up before your alarm goes off.
Automatically reorders beans before you run low.
Ring of sensors monitors every extraction (grind size, water flow, cup strength, temperature).
Whisper-quiet grinding at 58 dB.
Automatic milk steaming via motorized wand.
Self-rinsing after each cup.
Auto-shutoff after 20 minutes idle.
Dimensions: 32 × 24 × 41 cm, Weight: 9.8 kg.
Materials: Anodised aluminium with oak trim.
Available in Cream, Charcoal, and Terracotta finishes.
Water tank: 1.8 L (removable), Bean hopper: 250 g.
Pump pressure: 15 bar.
Drink options: Espresso, filter, long black, cappuccino, latte, tea.
Connectivity: Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz, Bluetooth 5.0.
Compatible with iOS 15+ and Android 10+.
Energy rating: A+.
Includes compostable pod option and plastic-free packaging.
Rated 4.8/5 from 214 verified owners.
Free delivery within 3–5 days with professional setup.
30-night trial with free returns.
2-year warranty (parts and labour).
